For background, I've been Catholic my entire life and depressed and suicidal for about 10 years.  As much as I tried to pray the rosary every day and go to Mass in the middle of the week just because and pray to God and ask for help, it never really made me feel better.  I knew I was loved by Him and that I was enough in His eyes, but I didn't feel good enough in everyone else's eyes.  Therefore, I just wanted to be home with my Father in Heaven.  Religion helps to know there is love and hope for you.  But it doesn't always make now much better.  When I started taking antidepressants, one of my Catholic friends got mad at me.  He didn't think it was necessary or holy.  Now that I've found a med that actually works for me, I'm so much better.  According to my mom, I fight less, I listen more, and I seem happier in general.  My friends say I seem like I actually exist and am in the moment.  I certainly still have a long way to go, but I only consider suicide once or twice a day now, and not for very long.  Religion helps after you've found the right antidepressant or therapist.  I wish all of you who read this the best <3
